quote: The task of paraphrase generation aims to reconstruct a sentence in a different surface structure (grammar and words) while preserving its underlying semantics. It plays an essential role in many downstream tasks like text summarization, machine translation, question answering, document modeling, and others.

Annotators rate each generated paraphrase on semantics, surface structure, and entity using a 1‑3 scale (bad/normal/good).

The semantics measures the degree of preservation of semantics. The structure evaluates the extent of variation in surface structure. The entity measures the accuracy and completeness of the generated entities.
